domains.tagline: Extinct within living memory. Unmistakable in silhouette.
domains.description: Thylacine — the Tasmanian tiger, gone since 1936 but instantly recognisable. A precise, specific name for AI work in conservation, de-extinction science, rare-signal detection, or anything trading on scarcity rather than a generic 'AI' suffix.
Pagan is an ancient, culturally resonant word with reach across technology, culture, media, nature and identity. Short, spoken easily, understood everywhere.

domains.tagline: Distance and clarity, in two syllables.
domains.description: Open, warm, slightly wistful — travel, wellness, and consumer health brands wear this comfortably.

domains.tagline: A wellness name with a wink.
domains.description: Plays on 'rather well' and 'rather, well —', giving a wellness or longevity brand something to build tone around.
The .at ccTLD completes the word cleanly. Distinctive, memorable, and unmistakably a considered pick rather than a fallback extension.
